heroHeadline: Russia Strikes Ukrainian Power Plants Despite Trump Energy Ceasefire Announcement
heroSubtitle: Russia continued striking Ukrainian power infrastructure despite U.S. President Trump's energy ceasefire proposal, with Zelensky confirming ongoing attacks — while separately, Zelenskyy offered to hold elections conditional on a 60-day ceasefire and halted drone strikes on Russian refineries if Moscow reciprocates.
